g.text: Esa gata, that freaky mutant cat
Keeps looking at my panquecitos like they're lunch
You mean Kalymos? I'll make sure she leaves your rats alone.
That thing is entrati's pet not yours
It looks at me just like he did
That thing is entrati's pet not yours
It looks at me just like he did
And how does she look at you?
She's a kavat, Lettie, not a person.
Like she's trying to figure out how to eat ME
Like one of those cavia you told me about
With too much intelligence behind those eyes
Like she's trying to figure out how to eat ME
With too much intelligence behind those eyes
Does the future have smart animals?
You told me about the cavia
Those poor animals that cabrón gave intelligence to and abandoned?!
Esa gata, it seems too smart to me
Looks at me with human intelligence
Does the future have smart animals?
Those poor animals that cabrón gave intelligence to and abandoned?!
How do you know she isn't one, too?!
There are the Cavia, who are these lab animals that were sent into the Void and came out intelligent. Well.
Yes, but - oh, this is going to piss you off already, I can tell.
How do you know she isn't one, too?!
I mean, she's never said anything.
I guess I don't really know.
Entrati is the one who tortured them
Does it have to do with entrati?
But she spies on us for him I know it
Entrati left, and she stayed. I don't think she's still working for him.
Do you really think she's spying on us for him? Why?
I AM GOING to make that cabrón HURT
Next time I see him I will torture him like he tortured those poor angelitos
And he will NOT like it, I PROMISE you THAT
It's exactly that reason why I think she is
He's gone and needs eyes here on us, ¿no?
Don't know why, pero no me gusta
Not my job to predict a crazy pendejo
He took these lab animals and sent them into the Void. They came out with the intelligence of people - it nearly killed them. They're called the Cavia.
Either way, she's smart enough to understand "If you mess with Lettie's rats, you sleep outside." Is that good enough?
I'm not kicking her out. Even if she's working for Entrati, it's not her fault. She's an animal being loyal to the owner who loves her. I can't be cruel to her.
And how are you so sure that this gata mutante is not one of these cavia
But if she hurts one of my bebecitos
Why did you have to put it like that
No me gusta cuando te pasas de listo, babas
She stays but if she hurts one of my bebecitos
